messages:
Alex Kim: Quick sync — RFC review block tomorrow. Need to lock who chairs each item and confirm pre-read coverage. 9am PT still ok for folks?
Maya Patel: 9am PT works for me. I can chair the infra RFC and do the pre-read tonight.
Samir Rao: I can take runtime perf but FYI I'm in GMT+1 so if we run late I might need to drop at +40m.
Jordan Lee: Happy to chair rollout policy + fallback. Can also act as backup reviewer for runtime if Samir has to leave.
Alex Kim: Great. Maya please mark the infra doc with high-level checklist (impact, perf numbers, rollout plan). Link: https://docs.redwood.inc/rfcs/infra-2026
Maya Patel: Done — added a short checklist and highlighted the perf table.
Alex Kim: For agenda ordering I'm thinking: infra (10m) -> runtime perf (15m) -> rollout (10m) -> 5m buffer for action items. Thoughts?
Samir Rao: That looks fine. Can we swap runtime and rollout if authors prefer?
Jordan Lee: Let's keep runtime in middle since it has more questions.
Alex Kim: Cool. Who's calling out pre-read confirmations? Would like authors to ACK by EOD.
Maya Patel: I'll ping authors in the doc and leave a comment: "Please ACK in thread when you've updated pre-read."
Samir Rao: I'll also add a short test-case checklist in runtime RFC so reviewers can quickly verify claims.
CI Bot: calendar: Event "RFC Review — 9am PT" created and invites sent to participants.ics
Alex Kim: Two quick ops asks: (1) If someone's unable to chair, please assign a proxy in this thread. (2) If you need more than allotted time call it out now.
Jordan Lee: Proxy note: if I need to swap, @Maya can take rollout.
Maya Patel: Happy to swap if needed. :thumbsup:
Samir Rao: If runtime needs +5m, I prefer we use the buffer. Otherwise we're good.
Alex Kim: OK locking agenda and chairs. Final pre-read reminder: authors, ACK by 6pm PT or we'll move you to the end. I'll post final agenda 6:15pm PT.
Maya Patel: Will ACK for infra now.
Samir Rao: ACK for runtime (added test cases).
Jordan Lee: ACK for rollout.
Alex Kim: Thanks all — posting final agenda in ~30m. :rocket:
